# Countdown count SFX cue via the ToneForge pipeline

## Goal

As a player, the 3-2-1 countdown plays a distinct audio tick each beat so the
restart feels deliberate and musical.

**User story:** *As a player*, each count of the restart countdown has its own
clear sound so I can hear the beat I will resume on.

## Context

Parent: Hull Full overlay: metronomic fire sounds + restart countdown
(AH-0MV0QPO4N009KWVT).

Producer decision: prefer a short synthesised **tone** cue; use a
public-domain voice countdown only if a suitable, licence-cleared voice asset
can be sourced. Any new cue must follow the existing ToneForge baked-asset
pipeline (recipe + manifest + checksum + cue-mapping doc). If a suitable
existing short tick cue already exists, reuse it and record the decision in a
comment instead of adding a redundant asset.

## Deliverables

- A distinct countdown cue (new `aihell-countdown-tick` recipe/asset, or a
  documented reuse of an existing cue) exposed as `playCountdownTickSound()`.
- Wiring in `audio/toneforge/recipes/`, `audio/toneforge/manifest.json`,
  `src/audio/cueManifest.ts`, the baked WAV + checksum, and
  `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md`.
- Tests: the cue is exported, mapped in the manifest and resolvable to its
  asset URL.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC4 — Beat-locked 3-2-1 countdown on selection:** when a selection is
  made, a distinct countdown count cue is available via
  `playCountdownTickSound()` for each of the three on-beat counts.
- [ ] A distinct countdown cue is available via `playCountdownTickSound()`.
- [ ] Every sound-producing cue remains present in the cue manifest —
  `src/audio/cueManifest.test.ts` and `src/audio/effects.contract.test.ts`
  pass.
- [ ] If a new recipe is added, the baked WAV renders deterministically and
  its checksum is committed; if an existing cue is reused, the decision is
  recorded in a work-item comment.
- [ ] `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md` documents the cue.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and the audio suites pass.

## Key Files

- `src/audio/effects.ts`
- `src/audio/cueManifest.ts`
- `audio/toneforge/recipes/` (new recipe, if added)
- `audio/toneforge/manifest.json`
- `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md`
- `src/audio/cueManifest.test.ts`, `src/audio/effects.contract.test.ts`

## Dependencies

- Test seams: deterministic beat-clock + recording SFX provider (first child).
data.title: Countdown count SFX cue via the ToneForge pipeline

# Demo/attract auto-select routes through the countdown

## Goal

As a demo/attract-mode viewer, the bot's auto-select drives the same
selection → countdown → resume path, so the run keeps its cadence and never
stalls.

**User story:** *As a viewer of attract mode*, the bot's upgrade pick still
plays the beat-locked countdown and gameplay resumes cleanly.

## Context

Parent: Hull Full overlay: metronomic fire sounds + restart countdown
(AH-0MV0QPO4N009KWVT).

The demo bot auto-selects via `autoSelectMs` / `autoSelectIndex` in
`MineralChoiceScene`, wired by `PlayScene` (AH-0MUXXQ1MN002RXGB). It must
route through the same 3-2-1 countdown path as a human selection.

## Deliverables

- The demo auto-select path goes through the 3-2-1 countdown and resumes on
  the beat, with no stall.
- Integration test in `src/scenes/demoMode.integration.test.ts` asserting the
  countdown runs and gameplay resumes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC6 — Demo/attract mode:** the existing demo auto-select still drives
  the same selection → countdown → resume path (no stall, no divergence).
- [ ] The demo integration test asserts the countdown runs and gameplay
  resumes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and the demo integration suite pass.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MineralChoiceScene.ts`
- `src/scenes/PlayScene.ts`
- `src/scenes/demoMode.integration.test.ts`

## Dependencies

- Beat-locked 3-2-1 countdown and on-beat resume.
data.title: Demo/attract auto-select routes through the countdown

# Documentation update for the hold-full metronome and countdown

## Goal

As a reader, all related documentation reflects the new overlay behaviour.

**User story:** *As a developer or player reading the docs*, the hold-full
overlay, the beat grid and the audio catalogue all describe the metronomic
fire and the 3-2-1 countdown.

## Context

Parent: Hull Full overlay: metronomic fire sounds + restart countdown
(AH-0MV0QPO4N009KWVT).

## Deliverables

- GDD §4.5 (hold-full choice) and §7.3 (audio) updated to describe the
  reduced-volume metronomic fire and the beat-locked 3-2-1 countdown.
- `README.md` updated where it describes the overlay and the beat grid.
- `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md` updated if a new cue is added.
- Code comments on the shared scheduler and the overlay resume contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC8 — Documentation:** all related documentation is updated to reflect
  the change, including code comments, the GDD (§4.5 hold-full choice / §7.3
  audio) and the README, plus `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md` if a new
  cue is added.
- [ ] Documentation-guard tests pass (e.g.
  `src/scenes/core/gymParityDocs.test.ts` and the `src/*Docs.test.ts` guards).

## Key Files

- `docs/Game Design Document.md`
- `README.md`
- `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md`

## Dependencies

- Beat-locked 3-2-1 countdown and on-beat resume.
data.title: Documentation update for the hold-full metronome and countdown

## Goal

Update the parity documentation and code comments to record that `GymLevel` (and therefore `GymBotTuning` and the Level Gym) consumes the shared live-aim and live-mineral-seek pushes.

## Context

Parent: Enemies do not target player in bot gym scene (AH-0MV4XFQ0J0082BN6). Governing rule: AGENTS.md Game Architecture Conventions; current docs at `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` §5.1 (Gym parity) and §7.3 (Live aim tracking).

## Acceptance Criteria

- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` §5.1 and §7.3 name `GymLevel` as a consumer of the shared live-aim push and the live mineral-seek push.
- Code comments in `src/scenes/gym/GymLevel.ts` and `src/scenes/core/enemyTargeting.ts` describe the shared seam and its ordering guarantee.
- Full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Key Files

- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — §5.1 gym parity and §7.3 live aim tracking
- `src/scenes/gym/GymLevel.ts` — code comments
- `src/scenes/core/enemyTargeting.ts` — code comments
- `README.md` — updated only if it references gym parity

## Deliverables

- Documentation and comment updates.
data.title: Docs: record live-aim parity for GymLevel
